coordinates.billboard_note: All strips are screen-facing. Quad sizes already include zoom. Ground ratio is baked. Use specified pivots and ground draw offset.

additive_blend.note: With One/One shader, multiply RGB by texture alpha exactly once. Preview uses SrcAlpha/One.

sampling.padding_note: Three clear texels INSIDE every cel edge; frame stride remains exactly frame width. Six clear texels across adjacent boundaries.

assets.optional_blend: alpha at same geometry, softer than preview
assets.placement_notes: Anchor centred pivot at hero chest. Example chest is 19px above feet for a 32px hero; use the current pose socket.

assets.optional_blend: alpha at same geometry, softer than preview
assets.placement_notes: Bottom-centre pivot. Place pivot 16 screen px BELOW feet so painted centre (64,32) lies under feet. This offset scales with quad height. Ground artwork is already squashed 0.5; apply no further Y squash.

assets.optional_blend: alpha at same geometry, softer than preview
assets.placement_notes: Anchor bottom-centre pivot at feet. Painted radial centre (80,116) sits 19 screen px above feet, matching chest. Uniform scaling only; no body silhouette.

sequence.clock_note: 600ms is anticipation. The 200ms flare plays at the charge-to-special handoff, without adding another pause. Client may align flare to its existing resolve; art does not alter simulation timing. Use presentation time while battlefield is frozen.
sequence.sprite_echo: Entirely client-owned: duplicate current frozen hero frame, expand from body midpoint and fade. No body artwork or silhouette is included in these PNGs.
sequence.cancel: Remove all supporting layers immediately on charge cancellation.
sequence.reduced_motion: Client may omit gather and release glint, retaining low-opacity ground illumination; no extra art supplied.

tint.neutral: Keep original near-white/pale-gold RGB for untinted use.
tint.white_core: Plain RGB multiplication colours white highlights. Use luminance-preserving tint or a separate white highlight pass.
tint.reference_formula: L=dot(texture.rgb,vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722)); h=smoothstep(0.82,0.98,L); output.rgb=L*mix(heroTint,vec3(1),h); output.a=texture.a*opacity. Formula inputs use the sampled RGB encoding consistently; preview evaluates normalized stored RGB.
tint.runa_formula: Before white-core mix, heroTint=mix(vec3(1,0.52,0.78),vec3(0.55,0.85,1),clamp((L-0.55)/0.28,0,1)). Pink stays in softer edges; aqua in middle values.
tint.colour_source: Primary tint values read from existing client render/charge.rs hero_colour. Runa secondary pink is an art-only recommendation matching owner aqua-pink brief.

preview.limits: Staged composites of real atlas hero crops. Sprite echoes intentionally omitted to isolate supporting art. Main preview uses requested solid background; scratch interactive review also offers a frozen arena with 80% scrim.
